games.name: Reminiscence Zombies
games.desc:
Reminiscence Zombies, originally known as TranZit: Remastered, is a round-based zombie survival game that takes its own spin on the zombie gamemode formula of Call of Duty World at War and the Call of Duty Black Ops series. Survive endless hordes of zombies with a variety of weapons, cosmetics, difficulties, custom perks, original and classic maps as well a whole new way of progressing!

--

Use code "WELCOME" to receive 250 Z-Tokens & a special cosmetic!

Premium players get 25% off cosmetic purchases. Double XP is enabled on weekends.

Private Servers offer Sandbox mode, which can be toggled on from the Reminiscence Hub.
